items.title: Kalshi files for Ohio and Tennessee rehearings based on CFTC new swaps rule
items.content_text: - **Kalshi files for Ohio and Tennessee rehearings based on CFTC new swaps rule** — Kalshi filed a motion for rehearing in the Sixth Circuit citing the CFTC Notice of Proposed Rulemaking published October 9, which seeks to include sports, politics, cultural and weather event contracts in the definition of swaps. The Sixth Circuit had ruled in September that Ohio and Tennessee could regulate Kalshi sports contracts under state gambling laws. ([Global Gaming Insider](https://globalgaminginsider.com/news/7867/kalshi-files-for-ohio-tennessee-rehearings-based-on-cftcs-new-swaps-rule))

items.title: TRUEiGTECH upgrades prediction market platform for multi-million event concurrency
items.content_text: - **TRUEiGTECH upgrades prediction market platform for multi-million event concurrency** — TRUEiGTECH announced on October 14 an infrastructure upgrade to its prediction market platform, adding in-memory order books, partitioned event pipelines and automated settlement using multiple oracles. The company said the system is aimed at sports, finance and event-trading operators in North America and Europe facing higher volumes. items.title: NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices
items.content_text: - **NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices** — An October 2026 NBER working paper by Eric Zitzewitz examined election prediction markets spanning 1880 to 2025, described as the largest sample of its kind. The study found no systematic partisan or demographic bias in election prices over the long run. ([RotoWire](https://www.rotowire.com/article/prediction-markets-go-back-to-future-with-election-trades-139104))

Activity is concentrated in a few headline races, with the top 1 percent of Polymarket wallets accounting for 70 percent of congressional betting volume. items.content_text: - **Prediction markets push into U.S. stocks raises regulatory alarm, Reuters reports** — Reuters reports traders have bet more than 220 million dollars on equity-linked markets on Polymarket International, mostly on individual stocks such as Nvidia, Alphabet, Apple and Tesla. items.content_text: - **CFTC proposes classifying event contracts as swaps while excluding casino-style gambling** — The CFTC has proposed treating sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as swaps under federal oversight, while excluding casino and sportsbook products, as appeals courts remain split and a related case is before the Supreme Court. items.title: Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows
items.content_text: - **Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows** — Kalshi filed with the CFTC to end its Volume Incentive Program no earlier than October 13, after September trading volume reached 52.98 billion dollars through September 29. items.title: Kalshi asks full Sixth Circuit to review panel decision favoring Ohio and Tennessee officials
items.content_text: - **Kalshi asks full Sixth Circuit to review panel decision favoring Ohio and Tennessee officials** — Kalshi filed a request on October 13 for the full Sixth Circuit to rehear its Ohio and Tennessee cases, arguing the panel misinterpreted the Commodity Exchange Act on two points. items.content_text: - **Ohio leads 39-state coalition urging Supreme Court review of prediction market case** — Ohio Attorney General D. Andrew Wilson led 39 states and the District of Columbia in an October 7 amicus brief asking the Supreme Court to decide whether state gambling laws apply to sports event contracts on federally regulated platforms. The brief cites the split between the Third and Sixth Circuits over federal preemption. items.title: Kalshi weather markets beat leading public forecast in six of seven cities, study finds
items.content_text: - **Kalshi weather markets beat leading public forecast in six of seven cities, study finds** — A study of Kalshi temperature markets since 2021 found the market-implied next-day forecast beat the National Blend of Models in six of seven cities, with about 10 percent lower error early in trading. items.title: Prediction market volume reaches record 78.2 billion dollars in September on sports trading growth
items.content_text: - **Prediction market volume reaches record 78.2 billion dollars in September on sports trading growth** — Prediction markets posted a record 78.2 billion dollars in notional volume in September, passing the previous high of 56.4 billion dollars set in July, as sports trading rebounded after a late-summer slowdown. Weekly volume recovered to about 19.9 billion dollars after slipping to roughly 10 billion dollars from late July to mid-August. ([Bonus.com](https://www.bonus.com/news/prediction-market-volume-hits-record-78-2b-in-september-as-sports-trading-accelerates/))

items.title: Kalshi announces 3 million dollar Housing Works partnership for New York healthcare

items.title: Kalshi clearinghouse files to add leverage to event contracts in push for institutional traders
items.content_text: - **Kalshi clearinghouse files to add leverage to event contracts in push for institutional traders** — Kalshi Klear, the prediction market's internal clearinghouse, has submitted a regulatory filing seeking permission to offer leverage on event contracts, a step aimed at drawing more institutional liquidity to the platform. Leverage would let traders take positions larger than their cash deposits alone would allow, and the change still needs to clear the regulatory process. items.title: Coinbase launches crypto price prediction markets with contracts as short as 15 minutes
items.content_text: - **Coinbase launches crypto price prediction markets with contracts as short as 15 minutes** — Coinbase opened crypto price prediction markets to US users on October 6, covering Bitcoin, Ether, Solana, BNB and other assets with time frames as brief as 15 minutes. The binary contracts pay 1 dollar if correct and 0 if wrong, can be funded with USD or USDC, run through CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets, and exclude Nevada. items.title: CFTC dual framework would treat exchange-traded event contracts as swaps, bookmaker bets as gambling
items.content_text: - **CFTC dual framework would treat exchange-traded event contracts as swaps, bookmaker bets as gambling** — The framework described in the report distinguishes products by market structure rather than event type. Contracts traded on multi-sided exchanges where holders can resell positions may be treated as swaps, while house-set bookmaker bets are treated as gambling. items.title: Polymarket CPI market leans slightly hot ahead of Wednesday September inflation print
items.content_text: - **Polymarket CPI market leans slightly hot ahead of Wednesday September inflation print** — A smaller Polymarket market on the September consumer price index, with about $155,000 traded, prices a 3.7% annual print at 44% and 3.6% at 43%, against a consensus forecast of 3.6%. The release is due Wednesday at 8:30 a.m. ET, ahead of the Federal Reserve decision on October 28. items.title: Analysis finds more than 50 new Polymarket wallets bet on US-Iran ceasefire ahead of announcement
items.content_text: - **Analysis finds more than 50 new Polymarket wallets bet on US-Iran ceasefire ahead of announcement** — Blockchain data analysis cited by Gamblerss found more than 50 newly created Polymarket accounts placed large Yes bets on a US-Iran two-week ceasefire in the hours before the announcement. items.title: Michigan Senate debate barely moved Kalshi prices, Action Network monitoring finds
items.content_text: - **Michigan Senate debate barely moved Kalshi prices, Action Network monitoring finds** — Action Network monitoring of Kalshi pricing around the Michigan Senate debate found little reaction, with El-Sayed holding at about 68 to 69 cents into Friday morning. Rogers edged up to a 32 cent bid and 33 cent ask by Friday morning, a small shift the analysis says was too minor to signal a lasting reassessment. items.title: Kalshi ends trading volume incentive program early on October 13 as regulators scrutinize incentives
items.content_text: - **Kalshi ends trading volume incentive program early on October 13 as regulators scrutinize incentives** — Kalshi filed with the CFTC to move the end date of its trading volume incentive program from October 1, 2027 to October 13, 2026, without giving a reason. The move follows reported CFTC attention to repeated trading patterns and wash trading concerns in prediction markets. items.title: Prediction markets give Bitcoin a 2% chance of reaching $200,000 in 2026, a record low
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets give Bitcoin a 2% chance of reaching $200,000 in 2026, a record low** — Kalshi prices Bitcoin trading above $200,000 by January 1, 2027 at 2%, with Polymarket at a similar level between less than 1% and 2%, down from around 4%. Total volume across the related Polymarket contracts exceeds $74 million, with Bitcoin trading near $82,000 to $84,000 in early October. items.title: Blockchain.com seeks CFTC approval to launch US prediction markets and crypto derivatives
items.content_text: - **Blockchain.com seeks CFTC approval to launch US prediction markets and crypto derivatives** — Blockchain.com has submitted applications for a designated contract market license and futures commission merchant registration with the CFTC. Approval would allow it to offer event contracts and crypto derivatives to retail and institutional customers in the United States under its own regulated structure. ([Crowdfund Insider](https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2026/10/317124-blockchain-com-seeks-cftc-approval-to-launch-us-prediction-markets-and-crypto-derivatives/))
